&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; list contains 'n' elements.</font></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="310" y="190" width="320" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="OWYXwDOWycamww-YB22I-6" value="" style="shape=curlyBracket;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;rounded=1;flipH=1;labelPosition=right;verticalLabelPosition=middle;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="260" width="20" height="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="OWYXwDOWycamww-YB22I-7" value="<font color="#0000cc" style="font-size: 18px;">T(n) = O(1), as all operations are constant.<br></font>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="310" y="310" width="360" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="OWYXwDOWycamww-YB22I-8" value="<font color="#990099" style="font-size: 22px;">Time Complexity = O(1) + O(n)*O(1) =&gt;
